title: VYB Chess
subtitle: Живият ум: an interactive chess book in Bulgarian
description: A Bulgarian interactive chess book for the browser and the desktop: six parts and 29 reading units of the manuscript, 351 board figures you can step through move by move, and selected positions turned into decision laboratories where you try the move before the author explains it.

title: BBeats
subtitle: A DAW in the browser
description: A browser DAW: lay down drum patterns and melodies on a step-sequencer timeline, stack instruments and Web Audio Module plugins per channel, mix the session, and export the beat as audio. React, Tone.js and PixiJS, with an Electron desktop build.

title: Memory Dungeon
subtitle: Seeker of Shards: a memory roguelite
description: A memory roguelite: read the board, match the pairs and protect the streak while relics bend the rules and every run deals deeper, harder boards. Run modes, a collection to unlock, local saves and an Electron build aimed at Steam.

title: Gem Dungeon Editor
subtitle: Explore connected rooms, save progress, and playtest your own
description: Explore a generated first-person dungeon with real room discovery, progression keys, connected corridors and a floor map. Save a chamber checkpoint, then open the original room, texture and mosaic tools. Edit a room and playtest it with the same keyboard and mouse controls. React Three Fiber, Rapier physics and Electron packaging.

title: Skyfall
subtitle: An endless dodger with heat, bosses and perk drafts
description: Survive the drop and reach the exit in Classic, Boss Rush or Draft. Keep the original skeleton character and procedural arena, choose a loadout, chase daily contracts, and spend earned rewards. Responsive menus and readable touch run controls complement the keyboard game.

title: SAAD Print-on-Demand
subtitle: Live graphic-apparel storefront
description: A live streetwear, racing, and graphic apparel storefront managed as a small revenue-generating print-on-demand product.

title: Cross Repo Libs
subtitle: Component showcase for the shared packages
description: A Storybook-style showcase of the packages shared across these projects: React UI pieces (buttons, cards, HUDs, dialogs, a pixel texture drawer), React Three Fiber props such as torches and braziers, a toast and confirm stack, and the local AI image, music and 3D generation helpers behind them.

title: Roam Rental Dashboard
subtitle: Search and preview rentals from a typed Next.js dashboard
description: A Next.js rental dashboard: type a search, watch the listings filter in, and open a preview card for each place. Typed listing models, a reusable data-fetching hook, styled-components and Jest tests, all running on local mock data.

title: Runner Score Arcade
subtitle: Dodge, collect, survive — the original stickman arcade
description: Dodge falling spikes with the original animated stickman and brick arena. Read drop warnings, collect six-second power-ups, survive escalating waves, and save genuine personal records on this device. Keyboard and touch controls, pause and replay.

title: Cat World
subtitle: An Angular adoption board for cats
description: An Angular single-page app for listing cats up for adoption: browse profiles, post and edit your own listings, message other users, and manage accounts from an admin view. An early full-stack-style project preserved with demo-safe backend boundaries.

title: User Hub Admin
subtitle: A Clarity-styled admin panel for managing users
description: An Angular admin panel built with VMware Clarity: create, view, edit and delete users from a dashboard with reusable form components and avatar fallbacks, with every record kept in the browser so the demo needs no server.

title: Pedal Rush
subtitle: The original blue MX-5, with an endless road ahead
description: A side-view endless driving game with the original blue MX-5, spinning wheels, illustrated scenery and gas/brake pedals. Accelerate from rest, coast or brake, change between three lanes, avoid traffic and chase a saved personal best. Includes keyboard and touch controls, health, pause and retry.

title: Flowforge Configurator
subtitle: A pipeline configuration form with drafts and tags
description: A React and Redux configuration form for pipeline-style records: load channels, edit fields and tags with validation, keep a local draft between visits, switch languages, and save a transformed pipeline object through a mocked API.

title: Gorilla Gainz
subtitle: Fitness gear, with the original Gorilla Gainz character
description: A React fitness store with its original gorilla imagery, green backdrop and sidebar catalogue. Browse and filter six illustrated products, inspect details, keep a shopping bag and try a clearly marked demo checkout. A local editor session supports product creation, updates and removal with persistent drafts and catalogue data.

title: Memory Card Quest
subtitle: Flip, match, and keep your lives
description: A React and Redux memory game with 6, 8 or 10 pairs. Match named symbols, earn hearts back, use keyboard grid controls, and improve the best move count saved for each board size.

title: Org Atlas Directory
subtitle: Browse companies, projects, employees and addresses
description: A React and Redux directory for connected enterprise data: pick a company and drill into its projects, employees and addresses with master-detail filtering, backed by a local JSON data source.

title: Gem Dungeon
subtitle: Three floors down, and every door out has a price
description: A first-person gem heist: each floor is a fresh dungeon, the exit charges a toll of three, five, then seven gems, and every gem you pocket wakes the Warden that walks the halls. Shove, sprint, and climb out with what you can carry. React Three Fiber, Rapier and Zustand, with an Electron shell for the Steam demo.

title: BOBBALL
subtitle: A dodgeball game against a man who did not sign up for this
description: Sixty seconds, endless balls, one Bob: a free browser dodgeball game with an active ragdoll of a photo-scanned man, on a rebuilt National Palace of Culture square in Sofia. Babylon.js and Havok in the page, a Cloudflare Worker leaderboard with a top five and a name filter, a walk-around mode, and a 30-second comedy trailer rendered frame by frame from the same scene through headless Chrome.

title: System Architecture Cheatsheet
subtitle: Interview reference as a React single-page app
description: A React + Vite single-page reference that lays out system-design building blocks - load balancing, caching, sharding, queues, consistency trade-offs - as a browsable interview cheatsheet.

title: Portfolio Website
subtitle: Recovered web project
description: Project search matches multiple terms; empty results and Escape restore focus.

title: Hosted Failover
subtitle: Keep static sites available when their primary origin fails.
description: Isolated real origin/failover demo; malformed URL and changed-root refresh fixes.

title: Portfolio Refinement Monitor
subtitle: Follow task progress through an interactive refinement session.
description: A Windows Electron dashboard for task ledgers, worker progress and refinement logs. The native demonstration runs fictional tasks in memory, with start, advance, pause and reset controls.
runCommand:
cd monitor-app
npm ci
npm run demo:native

title: Browser Automation Assignment

description: A browser automation command-line workflow that extracts structured member data. The reproducible local demonstration uses fictional fixtures; live Notion access requires authentication.

title: Weighted Draw Engine
subtitle: Explore weighted probabilities and sample outcomes.
description: A Python weighted sampling engine with input validation, duplicate merging and binary-search selection. The command-line demonstration explains probabilities and samples real results.

title: Bean Tapper Arena
subtitle: Race friends at tapping stations in a physical 3D arena.
description: A native S&box tapping game with physical bean avatars, station ownership, timed rounds and tournament scores. A refined world scoreboard, nearby-station action and guarded camera make the prepared local build easier to play and inspect.
runCommand: Open the project in the S&box editor.

title: Soundstage Composer
subtitle: Arrange piano ideas in a native BBeats-derived music editor.
description: A native C#/Unity UI Toolkit music editor derived from the actual BBeats frontend. Classical and Studio themes frame a horizontal arrangement, track mixer, searchable sound library, piano roll and note inspector, with original FMOD piano playback, undo and versioned composition files.

description: A C# integer range explorer that identifies fitting numeric types, including BigInteger for values outside the standard integer ranges.

title: Film Library
subtitle: Browse and search an offline collection of fictional films.
description: An Angular film library with fictional offline movies, search, film details, local posters and missing-page recovery.

title: C# Exercise Collection
subtitle: Run sixteen recovered numeric, text and geometry exercises.
description: A historical C# collection with sixteen native launcher entries, an interactive menu and explicit original-source mappings. Recovered implementations cover arithmetic, geometry, workdays, arrays and command interpreters; original fragments remain available for study.

title: Miata Lights
subtitle: Pop-up headlights in a native Android playground
description: The original teal Miata and parking scene, with amber side controls for Open, Wink, Sleepy and Blink. A native Kotlin/Compose app uses the model’s real headlight joints, front and three-quarter views, saved preferences and an optional phone flashlight link.
